title: plugin-auth: boot-time dev-seed retirement records revocations as admin_password_reset; add a dev_seed_retired reason (after #36311)
body:
repo:objectstack#4 · os-project-manager · session_01FEkQ5kt9AD1TPLy7Y9oa9D

Filing gate: ② follow-up from a landing PR (PR #36311, card #35184; seat 4's call 2026-11-22T05:36Z to keep the existing reason in that PR and hold a dedicated one here). Source: fleet. ⛔ Not a claim; not to be dispatched by area a4-E.

## Why

PR #36311 retires, at a boot outside development mode, the sessions and API keys of accounts still on their development-seed credential. It records them with the existing revoke reason `admin_password_reset`, so an audit reader sees "admin password reset" for a revocation no administrator made.

## Work

- Add a value such as `dev_seed_retired` to `sys_api_key.revoked_reason` (platform-objects select: value, label in every locale, field description, the reason vocabulary pin) and name it in `sys_session.revoke_reason`'s description.
- Have the boot-time retirement in `@objectstack/plugin-auth` (`dev-seed-credential-retirement.ts`) write it instead of `admin_password_reset`.
- Keep the restore semantics of a retired key the same as today's (a platform administrator's act).

## Done when

A retired session and key read `dev_seed_retired` in the record and in the console, in every locale; the retirement pins assert it; no other revocation path changes.

Land after PR #36311.
